pages.text: Each rod runs the reactor at full output for about $(bold)4 in-game days$().

pages.title: The Chain
pages.text: $(li)Deepslate Uranium Ore, Y -64 to -1: 1-2 Raw Uranium$(li)$(l:power/induction_furnace)Induction Furnace$(/l): Concentrate, 8 kW, 30 s$(li)4 Concentrate: 1 Pellet$(li)4 Pellets, 4 iron, 1 copper: 1 Rod
Only the Induction Furnace refines uranium.$(br2)$(danger)Uranium ore is mildly radioactive.$() Fortune and Silk Touch work on it.

pages.title: Rod Life
pages.text: Rod life shows as durability, counted in full-output seconds. Spent rods drop into the controller's output slot.$(br2)See $(l:reactor/spent_fuel)Spent Fuel$(/l).

pages.title: Fuel Rod
pages.text: Four pellets, four iron and a copper ingot.
